title: Aft Lower Shell Inner Doubler — Removal

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Removal of the inner doubler and the joint angle at a longitudinal skin joint of the aft lower shell, including the fastener removal sequence that keeps the skin land undamaged.

sections.purpose: This task gives the removal of one inner doubler and its joint angle from a longitudinal skin joint of the aft lower shell between stations C52 and C66.
sections.job_setup_note: The aircraft must be on its wheels or on jacks in the level attitude with the aft cargo compartment lining and floor panels already removed. The compartment must be dry. A fastener removal kit with the correct pilot drills is needed, and a vacuum extraction unit must be running at the work position throughout the drilling.
sections.procedure: 1. WARNING: DO NOT ENTER THE COMPARTMENT UNTIL THE AFT CARGO DOOR IS SAFE AGAINST INADVERTENT CLOSING. 2. Do the detailed visual inspection of the doubler and record the condition of the protective treatment before you remove anything. 3. Remove the drain grommets and the washers AGS334024-84 at the six positions of the joint. 4. Remove the sealant fillet along the joint edge with a non-metallic scraper. 5. CAUTION: DO NOT USE A METALLIC SCRAPER. A SCORE IN THE SKIN LAND IS A REPORTABLE FINDING. 6. Drill out the fastener heads in the sequence given on the joint diagram, working from the centre of the joint towards each end. 7. Punch the fastener shanks clear from the inside with the nylon drift. 8. Remove the joint angle D5331122892194 and then the inner doubler D5331120951225 or D5331121169495 as fitted. 9. Bag and identify the removed items if they are to be returned. 10. Clean the skin land and do a detailed visual inspection for corrosion, fretting or hole elongation. 11. Protect the open joint against moisture if the installation will not follow in the same shift.
sections.close_out: Make sure that all drilling swarf is removed from the joint land and from the compartment. Apply the temporary protection compound if the joint is to stay open. Record the condition of the skin land, including any finding, before the installation task starts.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. The part number of the removed doubler depends on the embodiment standard of the aircraft.

safety_precautions: Make sure that the aft cargo door is safe against inadvertent closing.
Put the warning notices in the flight compartment.
Use eye protection during all drilling operations.

tooling.description: Fastener removal kit with pilot drills
